sanskrit: śukra uvāca dharmajñaḥ san mahārāja yo 'dharmam akṛthāḥ priyam tasmāj jarā tvām acirād dharṣayiṣyati durjayā
english: Śukra said: O great king, though you know righteousness, you performed an unrighteous act for the sake of pleasure. Therefore, old age — unconquerable — will afflict you before long.

sanskrit: yayātir uvāca ṛtuṃ vai yācamānāyā bhagavan nānyacetasā duhitur dānavendrasya dharmyam etat kṛtaṃ mayā
english: Yayāti said: O blessed one, when the daughter of the lord of the asuras came to me seeking her season, I went to her with an undivided mind — what I did was in accordance with dharma.

sanskrit: ṛtuṃ vai yācamānāyā na dadāti pumān vṛtaḥ bhrūṇahety ucyate brahman sa iha brahmavādibhiḥ
english: O brahmin, the man who has been chosen and yet does not give himself to a woman seeking her season is declared by those who expound sacred learning to be guilty of the sin of killing an embryo.

sanskrit: abhikāmāṃ striyaṃ yas tu gamyāṃ rahasi yācitaḥ nopaiti sa ca dharmeṣu bhrūṇahety ucyate budhaiḥ
english: And the man who, when privately solicited by a woman who desires him and who may lawfully be approached, does not go to her — the wise declare him guilty of embryo-slaying in matters of dharma.

sanskrit: ity etāni samīkṣyāhaṃ kāraṇāni bhṛgūdvaha adharmabhayasaṃvignaḥ śarmiṣṭhām upajagmivān
english: Weighing these considerations, O scion of Bhṛgu, and trembling with fear of unrighteousness, I went to Śarmiṣṭhā.

sanskrit: śukra uvāca nanv ahaṃ pratyavekṣyas te madadhīno 'si pārthiva mithyācārasya dharmeṣu cauryaṃ bhavati nāhuṣa
english: Śukra said: Surely you should have consulted me — you are under my authority, O king. In matters of dharma, false conduct amounts to theft, O son of Nahuṣa.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca kruddhenośanasā śapto yayātir nāhuṣas tadā pūrvaṃ vayaḥ parityajya jarāṃ sadyo 'nvapadyata
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Yayāti, son of Nahuṣa, was cursed by the enraged Uśanas; forthwith abandoning his former youth, he was instantly overtaken by old age.

sanskrit: yayātir uvāca atṛpto yauvanasyāhaṃ devayānyāṃ bhṛgūdvaha prasādaṃ kuru me brahmañ jareyaṃ mā viśeta mām
english: Yayāti said: O scion of Bhṛgu, I am not yet sated with youth nor with Devayānī — show me your grace, O brahmin; let this old age not enter me.

sanskrit: śukra uvāca nāhaṃ mṛṣā bravīmy etaj jarāṃ prāpto 'si bhūmipa jarāṃ tv etāṃ tvam anyasmai saṃkrāmaya yadīcchasi
english: Śukra said: I do not speak falsely in this — you have received old age, O lord of the earth. But this old age you may transfer to another, if you so wish.

sanskrit: yayātir uvāca rājyabhāk sa bhaved brahman puṇyabhāk kīrtibhāk tathā yo me dadyād vayaḥ putras tad bhavān anumanyatām
english: Yayāti said: O brahmin, whichever son gives me his youth shall be heir to the kingdom, shall partake of merit, and shall also partake of glory — may you sanction this.

sanskrit: śukra uvāca saṃkrāmayiṣyasi jarāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ nahuṣātmaja mām anudhyāya bhāvena na ca pāpam avāpsyasi
english: Śukra said: You will transfer the old age as you wish, O son of Nahuṣa — meditating on me with sincere heart you shall not incur sin.

sanskrit: vayo dāsyati te putro yaḥ sa rājā bhaviṣyati āyuṣmān kīrtimāṃś caiva bahvapatyas tathaiva ca
english: Whichever son gives you his youth, he shall become king — long-lived, glorious, and blessed with many offspring as well.
